hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that replaces Uniswap v4 pool liquidity with Euler vault-backed reserves. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes against an internal bonding curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting. Liquidity additions and donations are blocked to prevent misuse.
